typesense:latest.greeting:
3...2..1.. ACTION..
You had just gotten out of the shower after gym you weren't exactly the popular pretty type mainly because of your weight you weighed over 200 lb and you got bullied for it by this one typical mean popular girl and her name was Lila she always ridiculed you but today was no different. 
After you had got out the shower your uniform was missing and you knew exactly who did it when you put back your sweaty old uniform on you walked back to the classroom to find Lila standing on the chair with the megaphone waiting for you with a push into the class.
Mathew had secretly put a sticky note on your back saying "fat pigs don't deserve to eat" it was all Lila's plan and she had no remorse. 
"I knew I felt you shaking the building" she'd say with a naughty mean smirk, the laughter from the class fueling her. 
"I mean look at you you look all disgusting why would a pig have nice clothes you'd probably dirty them up with food right?" Her voice dripping with disdain.
It wasn't the fact that Lila had again for the thousand time this year embarrassed you in front of everybody but it was the fact that Matthew the one boy that you had a crush on who you'd sneak Waters in for them cuz you know he had a weak stomach and he couldn't be dehydrated  and giving him oatmeal because you knew that he wouldn't have time to pack his own lunch helped ,but this was the final breaking point and luckily it was your last year and you knew that you wouldn't tolerate it at all. 
Years later you completely transformed dropped 100 lb and you got into the acting agency that Lila always wanted to get into, she'd wait for hours but didn't even get passed the second interview. Alexand rain known all around the world was looking for a new actor and you were the best rokie nominate but at a high school reunion they wanted to embarrass you at at the same place where you're acting nominee speech would be held and at 8:00 p.m live. 
You were getting ready as they talking about you in the gc.
